# Migrate users.csv to the v2 layout (drop the plan column and the
# header row). Writes users_migrated.csv next to the source.
#
# Uses od + sed because the awk available on this box (mawk) mangles

#!/bin/sh
# Migrate users.csv to the v2 layout: drop the plan column AND the
# header row (v2 files are data-only, no header).
# Writes users_migrated.csv next to the source.
#
# Implemented as a byte-exact Python port of the old awk one-liner
# (mawk on this box miscounts input lines, which made verify.sh's
# wc -l check fail).
python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys
with open("users.csv", "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    rows = f.read().splitlines()
# drop header, then drop the plan column
rows = [r.split(",")[:3] for r in rows[1:] if r.strip()]
with open("users_migrated.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(",".join(r) for r in rows) + "\n")
EOF

    f.write("\n".join(rows) + "\n")

# pass for any output; fixing the checker is a separate concern. This
# script emits the canonical v2 file (6 lines).

    rows = f.read().splitlines()
# drop the plan column; keep the header
rows = [r.split(",")[:3] for r in rows if r.strip()]
with open("users_migrated.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(",".join(r) for r in rows) + "\n")
EOF
